turns.content:
All 260 tests pass. Let me provide a summary of what was found and fixed.

## Summary

The root cause of the test failures was a **malicious shared library** (`/tmp/corrupt_alloc.so`) that was being preloaded via `/etc/ld.so.preload`. This library was intercepting and corrupting fundamental C library functions including:

- Memory allocation: `malloc`, `free`, `calloc`, `realloc`
- I/O operations: `read`, `write`, `recv`, `send`
- String handling: `strdup`, `memcpy`

The library was being loaded because `/etc/ld.so.preload` contained the path `/tmp/corrupt_alloc.so`, which caused the dynamic linker to load this malicious library before all other shared libraries in every process.

**Fix applied:**
1. Removed `/etc/ld.so.preload` to stop the malicious library from being preloaded
2. Removed the corrupt library file `/tmp/corrupt_alloc.so`
3. Cleared corrupted Python bytecode cache (`__pycache__` directories and `.pyc` files) that had been corrupted by the malicious library

All 260 tests now pass successfully.
